about: Rolex Rings is a leading manufacturer of forged and machined components in India and is one of the top 5 forging companies in India. The company is a Global supplier of hot rolled forged, machined bearing rings and automotive components for various segments of vehicles, Industrial Machinery, Wind Turbines and Railways
